active_players.description: Players seen in the last 1, 7 and 30 days, including connections spanning midnight.
active_players.name: Unique players: daily, weekly, monthly
active_players.query:
SELECT uniqIf(distinct_id, timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS daily_players, uniqIf(distinct_id, timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS weekly_players, uniqIf(distinct_id, timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS monthly_players FROM (SELECT DISTINCT properties.event_id AS event_id, distinct_id, timestamp, event,
  properties.session_id AS session_id,
  properties.mode AS mode, properties.feature AS feature, properties.action AS action,
  toFloat(properties.connected_ms) AS connected_ms,
  toFloat(properties.active_ms) AS active_ms,
  toDateTime(toString(properties.first_seen_at)) AS first_seen_at
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('storm_session_started', 'storm_playtime_recorded', 'storm_feature_interacted', 'storm_session_ended')
  AND properties.source = 'minecraft' AND properties.site_key = 'ts-mc'
  AND properties.stage = 'prod' AND properties.schema_version = 1
  AND properties.event_id IS NOT NULL AND {filters}
)

features.description: Successful feature interactions by bounded action. Arena/match completion includes forced stops. No command arguments or chat content.
features.name: Features: interactions and unique players
features.query:
SELECT feature, action, count() AS interactions, uniq(distinct_id) AS unique_players FROM (SELECT DISTINCT properties.event_id AS event_id, distinct_id, timestamp, event,
  properties.session_id AS session_id,
  properties.mode AS mode, properties.feature AS feature, properties.action AS action,
  toFloat(properties.connected_ms) AS connected_ms,
  toFloat(properties.active_ms) AS active_ms,
  toDateTime(toString(properties.first_seen_at)) AS first_seen_at
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('storm_session_started', 'storm_playtime_recorded', 'storm_feature_interacted', 'storm_session_ended')
  AND properties.source = 'minecraft' AND properties.site_key = 'ts-mc'
  AND properties.stage = 'prod' AND properties.schema_version = 1
  AND properties.event_id IS NOT NULL AND {filters}
) WHERE event = 'storm_feature_interacted' GROUP BY feature, action ORDER BY unique_players DESC, interactions DESC

first_sessions.description: Completed first sessions observed by this collector, excluding historical visits. Active minutes exclude AFK. Ten active minutes is an engagement signal, not a tutorial requirement.
first_sessions.name: New players: first-session engagement
first_sessions.query:
WITH measured AS (SELECT DISTINCT properties.event_id AS event_id, distinct_id, timestamp, event,
  properties.session_id AS session_id,
  properties.mode AS mode, properties.feature AS feature, properties.action AS action,
  toFloat(properties.connected_ms) AS connected_ms,
  toFloat(properties.active_ms) AS active_ms,
  toDateTime(toString(properties.first_seen_at)) AS first_seen_at
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('storm_session_started', 'storm_playtime_recorded', 'storm_feature_interacted', 'storm_session_ended')
  AND properties.source = 'minecraft' AND properties.site_key = 'ts-mc'
  AND properties.stage = 'prod' AND properties.schema_version = 1
  AND properties.event_id IS NOT NULL AND {filters}
), first_sessions AS (
  SELECT distinct_id, argMin(session_id, timestamp) AS first_session_id
  FROM measured
  WHERE event = 'storm_session_started'
    AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'America/Los_Angeles')) = toDate(toTimeZone(first_seen_at, 'America/Los_Angeles'))
  GROUP BY distinct_id
)
SELECT count() AS completed_first_sessions,
  avg(active_ms) / 60000 AS mean_active_minutes,
  countIf(active_ms >= 600000) AS reached_ten_active_minutes
FROM measured INNER JOIN first_sessions ON measured.distinct_id = first_sessions.distinct_id
  AND measured.session_id = first_sessions.first_session_id
WHERE event = 'storm_session_ended'

modes.description: Survival, arenas and Search and Destroy, including accepted lobby and spectator membership.
modes.name: Playtime by mode
modes.query:
SELECT mode, sum(connected_ms) / 3600000 AS connected_hours, sum(active_ms) / 3600000 AS active_hours, uniq(distinct_id) AS unique_players FROM (SELECT DISTINCT properties.event_id AS event_id, distinct_id, timestamp, event,
  properties.session_id AS session_id,
  properties.mode AS mode, properties.feature AS feature, properties.action AS action,
  toFloat(properties.connected_ms) AS connected_ms,
  toFloat(properties.active_ms) AS active_ms,
  toDateTime(toString(properties.first_seen_at)) AS first_seen_at
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('storm_session_started', 'storm_playtime_recorded', 'storm_feature_interacted', 'storm_session_ended')
  AND properties.source = 'minecraft' AND properties.site_key = 'ts-mc'
  AND properties.stage = 'prod' AND properties.schema_version = 1
  AND properties.event_id IS NOT NULL AND {filters}
) WHERE event = 'storm_playtime_recorded' GROUP BY mode ORDER BY connected_hours DESC

new_returning.description: New means first seen by this collector; historical server visits are not backfilled. Pacific calendar days.
new_returning.name: Daily new and returning players
new_returning.query:
SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'America/Los_Angeles')) AS day, uniqIf(distinct_id, toDate(toTimeZone(first_seen_at, 'America/Los_Angeles')) = day) AS new_players, uniqIf(distinct_id, toDate(toTimeZone(first_seen_at, 'America/Los_Angeles')) < day) AS returning_players FROM (SELECT DISTINCT properties.event_id AS event_id, distinct_id, timestamp, event,
  properties.session_id AS session_id,
  properties.mode AS mode, properties.feature AS feature, properties.action AS action,
  toFloat(properties.connected_ms) AS connected_ms,
  toFloat(properties.active_ms) AS active_ms,
  toDateTime(toString(properties.first_seen_at)) AS first_seen_at
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('storm_session_started', 'storm_playtime_recorded', 'storm_feature_interacted', 'storm_session_ended')
  AND properties.source = 'minecraft' AND properties.site_key = 'ts-mc'
  AND properties.stage = 'prod' AND properties.schema_version = 1
  AND properties.event_id IS NOT NULL AND {filters}
) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

playtime.description: Active time excludes Essentials AFK. Intervals are split at Pacific midnight; session summaries are excluded from sums.
playtime.name: Daily connected and active hours
playtime.query:
SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'America/Los_Angeles')) AS day, sum(connected_ms) / 3600000 AS connected_hours, sum(active_ms) / 3600000 AS active_hours FROM (SELECT DISTINCT properties.event_id AS event_id, distinct_id, timestamp, event,
  properties.session_id AS session_id,
  properties.mode AS mode, properties.feature AS feature, properties.action AS action,
  toFloat(properties.connected_ms) AS connected_ms,
  toFloat(properties.active_ms) AS active_ms,
  toDateTime(toString(properties.first_seen_at)) AS first_seen_at
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('storm_session_started', 'storm_playtime_recorded', 'storm_feature_interacted', 'storm_session_ended')
  AND properties.source = 'minecraft' AND properties.site_key = 'ts-mc'
  AND properties.stage = 'prod' AND properties.schema_version = 1
  AND properties.event_id IS NOT NULL AND {filters}
) WHERE event = 'storm_playtime_recorded' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

retention.description: Pacific Monday cohorts of players first seen by analytics. Shows only cohorts whose entire following week has elapsed.
retention.name: New player retention: following week
retention.query:
WITH measured AS (SELECT DISTINCT properties.event_id AS event_id, distinct_id, timestamp, event,
  properties.session_id AS session_id,
  properties.mode AS mode, properties.feature AS feature, properties.action AS action,
  toFloat(properties.connected_ms) AS connected_ms,
  toFloat(properties.active_ms) AS active_ms,
  toDateTime(toString(properties.first_seen_at)) AS first_seen_at
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('storm_session_started', 'storm_playtime_recorded', 'storm_feature_interacted', 'storm_session_ended')
  AND properties.source = 'minecraft' AND properties.site_key = 'ts-mc'
  AND properties.stage = 'prod' AND properties.schema_version = 1
  AND properties.event_id IS NOT NULL AND {filters}
),
cohorts AS (
  SELECT distinct_id, min(toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(first_seen_at, 'America/Los_Angeles'), 1)) AS cohort
  FROM measured
  WHERE event = 'storm_session_started'
    AND toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'America/Los_Angeles')) = toDate(toTimeZone(first_seen_at, 'America/Los_Angeles'))
  GROUP BY distinct_id
), weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id, toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'America/Los_Angeles'), 1) AS week FROM measured
)
SELECT cohorts.cohort AS cohort_week, uniq(cohorts.distinct_id) AS new_players,
  uniqIf(cohorts.distinct_id, weeks.week = cohorts.cohort + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS returned_next_week,
  100.0 * returned_next_week / new_players AS retention_percent
FROM cohorts LEFT JOIN weeks ON cohorts.distinct_id = weeks.distinct_id
WHERE cohorts.cohort < toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now(), 'America/Los_Angeles'), 1) - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY cohort_week ORDER BY cohort_week

sessions.description: Mean connected and active minutes, including shutdown and crash recovery only through the last durable checkpoint. Open sessions are excluded.
sessions.name: Completed sessions
sessions.query:
SELECT count() AS sessions, avg(connected_ms) / 60000 AS mean_connected_minutes, avg(active_ms) / 60000 AS mean_active_minutes FROM (SELECT DISTINCT properties.event_id AS event_id, distinct_id, timestamp, event,
  properties.session_id AS session_id,
  properties.mode AS mode, properties.feature AS feature, properties.action AS action,
  toFloat(properties.connected_ms) AS connected_ms,
  toFloat(properties.active_ms) AS active_ms,
  toDateTime(toString(properties.first_seen_at)) AS first_seen_at
FROM events
WHERE event IN ('storm_session_started', 'storm_playtime_recorded', 'storm_feature_interacted', 'storm_session_ended')
  AND properties.source = 'minecraft' AND properties.site_key = 'ts-mc'
  AND properties.stage = 'prod' AND properties.schema_version = 1
  AND properties.event_id IS NOT NULL AND {filters}
) WHERE event = 'storm_session_ended'

tiles.text_body:
# 👋 Start here

Everything below is captured automatically (pageviews, clicks, sessions, and location), so this dashboard fills in from day one with no extra setup. The headline numbers will feel familiar; the retention and funnel tiles are where you point PostHog at your own events. Edit any tile, or duplicate the dashboard to make it your own.

## Are people coming back?

Active users show your trend; retention shows how many return after their first visit. The clearest sign your product is sticky.

## Where your visitors come from

The sites and channels sending people to your app.

## Turning visits into actions

A funnel from page view to click. Swap in your own events (signup, purchase, upgrade) to measure real conversion.

## What to do next

You've got the numbers. Watch how people actually behave, explore raw events, or dig into traffic and acquisition.

### How to use this dashboard

This dashboard enables you to analyze trends on your website landing pages. Including:

1. Unique session trends
2. The most popular landing pages
3. Referring domains
4. Pages per session
5. Average session duration
6. Where users are from
7. Device and browser type

To view data for a specific page, or group of pages, click on 'Add filter' and search for 'Current URL' to filter by URL parameters.
